summary: Tested Leave & Holiday Policy end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass — GET returns seeded 2026 policy with 6 structure rows, 28 holidays, correct city entries (Sankranti/Pongal F for Hyderabad, Makara Sankranti V for Bengaluru on 2026-01-15, Delhi absent), 10 fixed per city, Delhi variable pool contains Ambedkar Jayanti / May Day / Raksha Bandhan / Maha Navami / Guru Nanak Jayanti; can_edit=true for CEO and false for Creative Director; PUT versioned edit+revert works; PUT returns 403 for non-admin; POST /share with empty recipients → 400; single-recipient share returns recipients=1; GET /banner returns today's IST date. Frontend (CEO admin@nylaairwater.earth): /company-documents?tab=leave opens directly, LeavePolicyDoc renders with all expected testids and content (title, structure=6, calendar=28, holiday-row-2026-01-15 shows Sankranti / Pongal (F) for Hyderabad, — for Delhi, Makara Sankranti (V) for Bengaluru; fixed-by-location has 5 cards; variable pool contains all 5 expected Delhi items; sections Variable Holiday Policy / Annual Paid Leave Summary / Compliance Note). Edit flow works: entitlement 0 updated with '(test)', ZZ Test Day added on 2026-12-31 (V) for Hyderabad, Save toast 'Leave policy saved (vN)', row holiday-row-2026-12-31 rendered, ZZ Test Day appears in Hyderabad variable pool. Revert (remove ZZ row + restore entitlement) works — 12-31 row disappears. Cancel discards changes. Share dialog: Send disabled when all-team unchecked + empty emails; enabled after entering qa-test@example.com; send returns success. /home and /dashboard both render leave-holiday-banner. Today block shows 'Ganesh Chaturthi · Fixed holiday' with all 5 locations on 14 Sep 2026. Policy link present.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/leave_policy.py POST /share: returns 200 even when all send_email() calls fail (sent==0). The email_configured flag `sent > 0 or False` is inaccurate — it can't distinguish 'server not configured' from 'configured but delivery failed'. Consider using a real config check.
backend/routes/leave_policy.py _fmt uses strftime('%-d %b (%a)') which is Linux-only (not portable to Windows); acceptable here since the runtime is Linux.

frontend LeavePolicyDoc.js ShareDialog defaults all_team=true. Given the review-request warning that real emails are configured, defaulting to true is risky — recommend defaulting to false, or requiring an explicit confirmation when all_team=true.

backend PUT /api/leave-policy: the payload writes the client-supplied version-independent structure but doesn't concurrency-check against current version — a stale client editor could overwrite a newer save. Consider ETag/If-Match or version-in-body check.

Note: /company-documents is guarded by module-level role permission; Creative Director gets 'Access Denied' on the whole page, so the 'read-only Leave Policy tab for non-admin' scenario in the review can't currently be exercised through the UI. Backend RBAC (PUT 403) is verified. LeavePolicyDoc already correctly gates Edit visibility via can_edit.
rca of the issue: Non-admin RBAC on Leave Policy tab: The Company Documents page enforces module-level permission ('company_documents') via a role guard, showing 'Access Denied' for Creative Director. The review request assumes a lighter guard (authenticated tenant member) so any user can read Leave Policy but only Admin/CEO can edit. Recommended fix (Option 1): exempt the 'leave' tab from the module guard and rely on can_edit for edit-visibility (already correctly implemented). Option 2: grant Creative Director company_documents.view. Option 1 aligns with existing LeavePolicyDoc behavior.
